generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 8 medieval RPG inventory item icons, production transparent atlas.
Generate ONE genuine transparent RGBA PNG image, STRICT 4 COLUMNS by 2 ROWS of equally sized square cells, overall aspect 2:1. Exactly EIGHT isolated pixel icons in fixed row-major order below. References are existing items.png and inventory-bag.png: match their tiny warm muted palette, dark brown pixel outline, clean simplified silhouette, flat clusters. Intended final size 64x32 px, each cell 16x16; design icons to read clearly at only 12-14 LOGICAL pixels within each cell and transparent 2px gutters. Few broad pixel clusters and recognizable shapes; do not depend on tiny fine detail. Each icon centered, equal visual weight. No box, panels, frames, labels, letters, checkerboard artwork, background, cast shadows, scenery, glow, photo textures or smooth vector edges.
TOP ROW left to right:
0 Small compact PROVISIONS bundle: two golden bread loaves, red-brown bacon and cream cheese visibly together as one compact food arrangement. No bag disguising all food.
1 Brown LEATHER WATERSKIN: rounded pear-shaped brown skin flask, tiny tied neck and shoulder strap, clear dark outline.
2 Small straight FAMILY DAGGER inside BROWN LEATHER SHEATH: short straight modest steel hilt exposed from sheath, diagonal; not a big sword, no enchantment.
3 One SMALL SILVER COIN: round silver-gray visibly silver, simple light metallic facet or center dot, absolutely not copper/brown/gold.
BOTTOM ROW left to right:
4 Compact TRAVEL GEAR bundle: rolled GREEN cloak and brown WOOL blanket strapped together with pair of small tan LEATHER SHOES in front, reads as grouped packed travel gear.
5 Small AMBER TINCTURE BOTTLE alongside folded cream LINEN BANDAGE, simple cork.
6 Closed HERBAL BOOK: brown leather cover, tiny distinct GREEN LEAF symbol, no readable title.
7 Closed ALANA STORYBOOK: dark BLUE and brown cover, tiny gold story STAR/spark emblem, no runes or readable letters.
All eight exactly in those cells, no extras. Clear opaque color clusters on genuine transparent alpha; small polished grounded medieval game icons.

processing: Split equal 4x2 source cells. Clean generated alpha using threshold 110, crop opaque silhouette and resize using nearest-neighbor so longest edge is 12px. Center within each 16px cell, preserving at least 2px transparent gutters. Quantize generated RGB to 48 colors without dithering and restore clean generated alpha. No creative raster drawing.

checked: All eight fixed indices present and visually inspected after normalization.
Green travel roll, brown waterskin, sheathed dagger and contrasting book colors survive normalization.
All cells have transparent gutters and no text/frame.
knownLimits: Individual bacon/cheese and shoes/blanket details are intentionally compact and are clearer at UI enlargement.
Tiny leaf and story-star symbols are pixel clusters; inventory text must supply book identity.
